# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `canva` MCP server pointing at Canva's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.canva.com/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with Canva user login (authorization code + PKCE, dynamic client registration, Client ID Metadata Documents) — no API key, client ID, or Developer Portal app to configure.
- Logo: Canva's official mark, the 180×180 web app icon published on canva.dev.
